_comment: Attestation record for the planar-2R exact-witness worked instance (L1=L2=5, t1=1/2,
t2=-1/3; the same instance tests/test_checkers.py and tests/test_attestation.py use),
checked against robocert.checkers.planar2r_attested_witness_checker, which requires
lean4, rocq, and isabelle (robocert.checkers.PLANAR2R_ATTESTATION_POLICY).
This file is a SOURCE record, not itself a certificate payload -- scripts using it copy
the `attestations` object verbatim into a Certificate's payload['attestations']. Keys
outside `attestations` (`sources`, `statements`, `pending_systems`) are repo-side
bookkeeping and are NOT part of the wire format that src/robocert/attestation.py reads.
The lean4 entry records `lake build` plus scripts/check_lean_axioms.py confirming
RoboCert.exactWitness_sound depends on exactly
[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -- no sorryAx. That theorem is the soundness
statement for exactly the checker this instance's certificate uses.
The rocq and isabelle entries were transcribed after reviewing exact-head CI run
33356967720 at commit 0531db56736b4777b9323de03a60c4b684dea486. Each required
kernel reran through the hardened path, its planted positive control passed, every
digest and certificate binding matched the committed files, and all real declaration
axiom/oracle sets were empty. The downloaded evidence remains provenance rather than
an attestation entry; future CI reruns promoted systems and fails closed on drift.
Consequence, verified by scripts/check_attestations.py and pinned by
tests/test_attestation.py: this record now satisfies PLANAR2R_ATTESTATION_POLICY.
That policy result covers the recorded proof-assistant evidence only; it does not
register a production checker, promote an RC claim, or establish Python/model or
physical-model correspondence.
